chapter_title: Concerning the Three Images that are in the righte
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

** ¶2:** Three degrees of interior life arise in the person under going regeneration.

**¶ 3:** The first is the in most degree of the mind, which is the regener ate will and understanding; this the Lord through Divine Truth forms within the person, flowing into the inter iors and dwelling there as a living presence .

**¶4:** The second degree is what remains and pers ists of the regenerate life into the middle or natural-rational mind — that interior life which is still held capt ive within the inherited proprium, as the old unre generate will has dominated this rational degree since the earliest states of its formation .

**¶5:** The third is the ou termost sens ual degree of the mind, which encompasses and is adjo ined to both of the interior degrees.

**¶6:** These three degrees constitute the whole mind . When goods and truths are received from without through the appropri ation of what is good and true in daily life — if that living substance desc ends into the ou termost sensual degree, the sens ual mind separ ates from it whatever belongs to mere bod ily appearance and fall acy , and deposits it among the forms proper to that degree. Then as it rises in ward and passes into the natural -rational degree , that middle mind in turn separates from it whatever belongs to the evil spirits who act through it — [ the text here names what corresponds to] wrath from self-love, and concupiscence [ and further ev ils that c ling to it at this level].

**¶7:** Then the aff ection of pure truth descending from the Lord reveals the in most degree of the mind where the regener ate life truly exists . This aff ection of truth serves as a guide: it goes before, drawing the pur ified good up ward into interior and celestial states, where it is received into the in most degree of the mind. There the Lord through this affection fash ions and orders the regenerate will and understanding with tru ths arranged in heavenly form . Every faculty of the inner person is confirmed and sealed by this pure aff ection of truth which is present and ab ides within the regenerate life .

**¶8:** This , then, is how every particular good poss essing life from the Lord is purified and made to live — the good that enters the external life of the regenerating person from without, through the daily appropriation of goods and truths of every kind. The living substance of good is wholly cleansed each day as it passes through all three degrees of the mind, being purified at each .

**¶9:** At the ou termost degree it puts off what belongs to the body and the senses, which is not its own. At the middle degree it likewise puts off the evil aff ections that are not its own but have become min gled with it through inheritance and habit — w rath, concupiscence, v ain glory, fool ishness, envy, and the love of cont ention — together with all the fals ities from hell that do not belong to it.

** ¶10:** But in the inmost degree itself , the living good truly lives and is con joined with patience flowing from charity, the fullness of faith , and celest ial love which governs all the degrees beneath it. It is the aff ection of pure truth from the Lord that clothes the regenerate mind with truths, and this state is r ightly called * the state of life itself*. This aff ection is first , because it initi ates regener ation as the earliest stir ring of new life; but it is also last, because it is the Lord Himself who is the beginning and the completion of all regeneration — the Alpha and the Omega in whom every degree finds its end .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three images occur in the elect person.
The first is the spiritual image, which is the new man, which the Light Mind shall form in him; and it goes into him and dwells in him.
The second image is the remnant and remainder of the new man, which is the psychic image that is bound in the flesh, as the old man [has dominated it since the earliest] times of this psychic image.
The other one is the corporeal image [that is] added to them all.

These three images [are in him] entirely. When it will [enter into him] through the nourishment of food. If it shall sink [and go] down to the corporeal image. [And] the corporeal, [that] is in it, shall divest itself of it and place it in the [corporeal] image. [Then] again it rises up and falls to the [psychic] image; it shall divest itself of the psychical of the enemies, which [stir up in it] anger. The lust [and all other evils that are mixed] with it.

Then shall a Light Virgin come and reveal the spiritual image that is [there], which [is] the new man. That virgin acts as a guide. [She g]oes on before and it is extended to the heights above, and received into this spiritual image. And she [sculpts] it and adorns it with the new man [wi]thin. It is sealed with all the limbs of this Light Virgin who is present and dwells in the new man.

So, this is [h]ow this living limb shall be [puri]fied and live, the one that comes into the body of [the ri]ghteous one from without through the administration of food of various ki[nds], like this. The living soul shall be clea[n]sed entirely every [d]ay and traverse these three [im]a[ges].

So, it shall divest itself of the body, which is not its own, in the corporeal. It shall also divest itself of the souls that are not its own, these that are mixed with it in the psychical [image, namely] anger and desire and [haughti]-ness and foolishness and envy and strife; and these other wicked teachings that are not its own.

However, in [the] spiritual image itself it shall live and be joined with [lo]ng-sufferingness, the perfection of faith and love that reigns over them all. It is the Virgin of Light who robes the new man and who shall be cal[l]ed 'the hour of life'. S[he] is the f[irst], but s[h]e is also the last.
